items.html: And behold, the reason for their clinging now in the aspect of back to back, which was not so at first when she was in the aspect of a point, as above — for she was with him face to face at the end of his Yesod. The reason is that all aspects of the Achoraim are judgments, and they are the names of Elokim, as is known; and the Klipot cling to those Achoraim, which are the name Elokim, as is known, in the secret of "God reigns over the nations," as mentioned in Saba deMishpatim.
